name: Bozhestvennaja Novella
source:
..Inspired by Dante’s “Divine Comedy,” Nietzsche’s “Thus Spoke Zarathustra,” and the mystical visions of Alexander Scriabin. Through the tenderness and trembling charm of catgirls, this story attempts to express a unique philosophy — its core idea being “Art as Meaning.”..

Finding yourself in another world, you suddenly hear the melodies of the Universe itself… Meeting three gentle, ear-tailed sisters, you face a divine task — to stop the Musical Ether at any cost, for it brings the catgirls and all living beings growing pain and endless despair...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863410]Steam[/url]]
translation:
..受到但丁的《神曲》、尼采的《查拉图斯特拉如是说》和亚历山大·斯克里亚宾的神秘幻象的启发。这个故事试图通过猫女的温柔和颤抖的魅力来表达一种独特的哲学——其核心思想是“艺术即意义”。

发现自己身处另一个世界，你突然听到了宇宙本身的旋律……遇见了三个温柔的耳尾姐妹，你面临着一项神圣的任务——不惜一切代价阻止音乐以太，因为它给猫女和众生带来越来越大的痛苦和无尽的绝望……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863410]Steam[/url]]
